name: 风起云涌2
english_description: Part of the same "Ocean" codebase lineage as several sibling archives in this project, sharing their distinctive hardcoded backdoor admin mechanism. Features a larger-than-usual map including the classic sects alongside an independent Assassins' Tower faction and a marriage system, blending social and underworld gameplay. Its admin roster is stored not in a plain text file but inside the security daemon's own save data.
